interpretation.analysis: Post-hoc Boolean compositions of stored per-case EXISTS witnesses
interpretation.events: Cases were not shown to be logically related incidents. AND/OR describe imposed preservation requirements only
interpretation.identity: Full T distributions characterize symmetric count utilities, not requirements for named case subsets
interpretation.independence: No independence assumption or product approximation used for reported empirical AND/OR
interpretation.novelty: Known dependence/provenance identities; contribution is telemetry-specific empirical diagnosis
interpretation.uncertainty: 16 fixed labels; exact enumeration does not create independent data or a population probability estimate
interpretation.workload: Uniform equal weight over all q-subsets is an analytic reference, not an observed operating workload
